final_brief.subject: Food delivery market in India
final_brief.executive_summary: The India online food delivery market stands at USD 55.58 billion, growing at a 22.18% compound annual growth rate through 2034. Revenue in the Online Food Delivery market is projected to reach US$61.76bn in 2026. Major metros including Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Chennai dominate due to dense population. Key opportunities in the India online food delivery market include cloud kitchens and AI personalization, with a focus on expanding into Tier II and Tier III cities. key_observations.text: The India online food delivery market stands at USD 55.58 billion, growing at a 22.18% compound annual growth rate through 2034.
Revenue in the Online Food Delivery market is projected to reach US$61.76bn in 2026.
Major metros including Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Chennai dominate due to dense population.
Key opportunities in the India online food delivery market include cloud kitchens and AI personalization, with a focus on expanding into Tier II and Tier III cities.
Approximately 66 million urban consumers used food delivery platforms in 2024, while the market generated an estimated 2.0 billion delivered meal orders in 2025.
Order frequency, cuisine discovery, convenience and reduced meal preparation time remain the primary commercial demand levers.

findings.claim: The India online food delivery market stands at USD 55.58 billion, growing at a 22.18% compound annual growth rate through 2034.
findings.evidence: India has quietly become the most disruptive food delivery market on the planet. Not the largest by GMV that’s China but by innovation velocity, platform intensity, and the sheer density of competition at every level from restaurant aggregation to 10-minute grocery delivery. In 2026, the India online food delivery market stands at USD 55.58 billion, growing at a 22.18% compound annual growth rate through 2034, the fastest-growing food delivery market in the world, and one that consistently produces innovations that later appear in Western markets years later.
